reason: Independent source review found that the raw adapter accepted ASCII control identifiers which the fixed MoonTxnWitness b663 core rejects. This is a representation-domain issue, not a checker consistency discrepancy. The original fifteen ASCII cases and all expectations are unchanged.

identity.forbiddenScalars: U+0000 through U+001F inclusive, U+007F; unpaired surrogate code units are invalid Unicode
identity.allowedExamples: U+0020 space, leading/trailing spaces, U+0080, scalar noncharacters, supplementary scalar characters within the UTF16 limit
identity.outsideScope: String business values are not identifiers. No normalization, trimming, case folding or Unicode equivalence is applied.

boundaryPolicy: The new frozen boundary fixture is checked remotely by importing the actual v2 adapter. Direct identity and full-trace cases have fixed expectations. Boundary cases do not invoke Elle and are not counted among the original eight actual checker cases.
